items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Begaard wasn't playing clarinet at all... But Lorenzo said he thought that he would be the better instructor for me... So he had the choice of either sending me to Adolf Alexander or Begaard. So he said, well I think I'd rather send you to Begaard.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was noticing Saeed the other week, he seems to hit the bass drum on one and three. One and three. That's right. That's the two beat. That's what they call the two beat. The one and three. And then his snares seem to more accent the two and four.
That's right. That's correct. Now, Begaard is another one of his... Pupil.
Yeah, Begaard coming around. Wow. He told us all about him too. He tried a bit about his lessons with him too. Usually, how often did he teach a pupil? One after... Twice a week. Twice a week.
